web_blocks.html: What Coforge Does: Coforge Limited (NSE: COFORGE, formerly NIIT Technologies) is a ₹89,051 Cr domain-led Indian IT services, BPM, and digital engineering firm [1, 11, 24]. It serves global clients in Banking & Financial Services (BFS), Insurance, Travel, and Healthcare/Hi-Tech. In May 2026, Coforge closed its $2.35B Encora acquisition and merged Cigniti Technologies [6, 8]. Today, the combined firm annualizes roughly ₹24,683 Cr in revenue (Q2 FY27: ₹6,170.8 Cr, +53.6% YoY) with a record $2.38 billion 12-month executable order book [5].

web_blocks.html: Bull vs. Bear & Multi-Horizon Outlook: Bulls highlight 4-for-4 M&A integration success, 20%–25% Encora G&A cost synergies, and a 22.6% P/E discount to Persistent Systems [5, 7, 25]. Bears point to ₹6,026 Cr in borrowings, ~20% equity dilution, flat Q2 Encora QoQ revenue, and 88-day FY26 debtor days [1, 6, 8]. Weighing both sides: Short-Term (1–3M) favors a VCP breakout above ₹2,150 toward ₹2,255–₹2,400. Medium-Term (6–18M) earns an ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP targeting ₹2,620 (+30.3%). Long-Term (3–5Y) remains a COMPOUNDER_PASS if DSO normalizes below 82 days and debt declines.

book_paragraphs: Welcome to our institutional dossier on Coforge Limited. Before we dive into ten years of financial forensics, customer case studies, and technical charts, let us put the conclusion right on the table so you know exactly where this investigation lands and why.

At its core, Coforge is a specialized, domain-led Indian IT services and digital engineering compounder. Under CEO Sudhir Singh since 2017, the firm has grown revenue from ₹2,372 Cr in FY15 to ₹16,403 Cr in FY26 and ₹20,380 Cr on a trailing twelve-month basis through September 2026. In May 2026, Coforge closed its largest strategic bet yet—the $2.35 billion acquisition of Encora—creating a global digital engineering powerhouse with ₹6,170.8 Cr in Q2 FY27 quarterly revenue and a record $2.38 billion 12-month executable order book.

On our strictly price-blind fundamental audit, Coforge earned a COMPOUNDER_PASS with a kpi_health rating of PASS_WITH_WATCH. Why the watch flag? Because Encora lifted borrowings from ₹728 Cr to ₹6,026 Cr, expanded intangibles to ₹23,592 Cr, diluted equity by roughly 20%, and arrived alongside FY26 debtor days stretching to 88. Those are real balance-sheet obligations that demand cash-conversion discipline over the next four quarters.

When we unlocked the November 16, 2026 market tape, Coforge closed at ₹2,010.00 (40.06x TTM P/E)—a 22.6% discount to Persistent Systems (51.75x) despite faster headline growth and an upgraded 16.0% FY27 EBIT margin target. Technically, the stock is in Week 16 of a confirmed Weinstein Stage 2 uptrend, coiling in a tight 10.76% Bollinger-band Volatility Contraction Pattern just 4.35% above its 10-week EMA (₹1,956.01).

Putting fundamentals, Reverse DCF, and the Stage 2 tape together yields an earned ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP at Tier-2 conviction, with a Base target of ₹2,620.00 (+30.3%), Bull target of ₹2,950.00, Bear target of ₹1,620.00, and a hard structural stop at ₹1,659.40 (1.53:1 support-zone asymmetry). Because your consolidated Zerodha ledger holds zero shares of Coforge (NOT_HELD), we recommend deploying 50% of a marginal cash tranche in two halves—half at CMP ₹2,010 and half on any dip into ₹1,927–₹2,039—while keeping 50% in cash.

book_callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION: How to Read This Dossier
book_callouts.text: Chapters 1 through 6 were written completely price-blind so that a rising stock chart could never bias our view of Encora's debt or working capital. Chapters 7 through 9 then confront that locked business reality with today's ₹2,010.00 price tag.

book_subsections.title: Summary of Key Numbers, Milestones & Risk Guardrails
paragraphs: Keep five anchor numbers in mind as you read the chapters ahead. First, Q2 FY27 revenue reached ₹6,170.8 Cr (+53.6% YoY) with a $2.38 billion 12-month executable order book (+45% YoY). Second, management raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16.0%, targeting 17.0% by Q4 FY27. Third, post-Encora borrowings stand at ₹6,026 Cr and FY26 debtor days stretched to 88—our primary operational watch items.

Fourth, at ₹2,010.00 (40.06x TTM P/E), Coforge trades at a 22.6% discount to Persistent Systems (51.75x) and sits just +4.35% above its 10-week EMA in a Week-16 Stage 2 VCP squeeze. Fifth, our Tier-2 ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP carries a ₹2,620.00 Base target (+30.3%) and a non-negotiable ₹1,659.40 structural stop.
